title: When Agent Automation Becomes Profitable: Quantifying and Insuring Autonomous AI Risk through Trace-Economic Underwriting
title_zh: Agent 自动化何时变得有利可图：通过 Trace-Economic Underwriting 量化并承保自主 AI 风险
abstract_en: AI agents can now take irreversible actions in operational systems, but agent-caused losses are still not clearly assigned, priced, or transferred. Providers often disclaim consequential damages, users are left with uncompensated losses, and default human review limits the efficiency gains of automation. We ask when autonomous AI deployment can become economically acceptable despite failure risk. Our answer is to quantify risk at the customer-task-trace episode level and transfer it through insurance. Automation is acceptable when its expected benefit exceeds the premium, control cost, and remaining risk. This requires a defined role with bounded permissions and comparable traces. We introduce trace-economic underwriting, which maps tool-use traces to customer exposure and claimable loss, then uses this representation for pricing, control, and risk transfer. It uses deterministic economic labels rather than an LLM judge. In our trace-to-loss testbed, trace-economic pricing reduces pricing MAE from $17.7K to $569 and removes regressive cross-subsidy. A 300-trace expert audit accepts 295 labels unchanged. On 1,000 real SWE-smith traces, trace-conditioned controls reduce CVaR95 by 72%. Theorem~1 gives a finite-sample scope condition. We release code, labels, and audit sheets.
abstract_zh: 本文关注自主 AI agent 在真实业务系统中执行不可逆操作时的风险定价与责任转移问题。当前，agent 造成的损失往往难以归责、定价或保险化：服务商通常拒绝承担间接损害，用户则可能承受未补偿损失，而默认的人类审核又限制了自动化效率收益。作者提出，当自动化带来的期望收益超过保险费、控制成本与剩余风险时，自主 AI 部署才具有经济可接受性。为此，论文提出 trace-economic underwriting：在客户-任务-trace episode 粒度上，将工具调用 trace 映射到客户风险敞口与可索赔损失，并据此进行定价、控制和风险转移。该方法依赖确定性的经济标签，而非 LLM judge。实验显示，在 trace-to-loss testbed 中，trace-economic pricing 将定价 MAE 从 17.7K 美元降至 569 美元，并消除了累退式交叉补贴；300 条 trace 的专家审计中有 295 条标签被原样接受；在 1,000 条真实 SWE-smith traces 上，基于 trace 的控制将 CVaR95 降低 72%。论文还给出有限样本适用范围条件 Theorem 1，并开源代码、标签与审计表。
key_points_zh: 提出 trace-economic underwriting，将 agent 工具调用 trace 映射为客户风险敞口和可索赔损失，用于保险定价、风险控制与责任转移。
给出自动化是否经济可接受的判据：期望收益需高于保险费、控制成本和剩余风险，且 agent 角色需权限有界、trace 可比较。
方法使用确定性经济标签而非 LLM judge，提升可审计性与保险场景下的可解释性。
在 trace-to-loss testbed 中，定价 MAE 从 17.7K 美元降至 569 美元，并消除累退式 cross-subsidy；专家审计 300 条 trace 中 295 条无需修改。
在 1,000 条真实 SWE-smith traces 上，trace-conditioned controls 将 CVaR95 降低 72%，表明基于 trace 的控制可显著降低尾部风险。

llm_assessment.comment: A strong governance-oriented agent infrastructure paper that links execution traces to economic risk pricing, controls, and insurability.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 这是一篇很有价值的智能体治理基础设施论文，将执行轨迹与经济风险定价、控制和保险机制联系起来。
